directedDefects.literal: В Unity при Time.timeScale = 0 приложение ведёт себя как на паузе, если все функции независимы от частоты кадров.
directedDefects.ground: The conditional technical statement is true in Unity’s completeDescriptionL239–L246:timeScale is in-game-time rate relative toreal time andzero behaves aspaused if allfunctions areframe-rate independent. But the note omits that definition and presents an unexplainedAPI expression plus an unexplained programming qualifier. For a general adult player learning the difference between save andpause, this is not a self-contained useful pause fact without prior engine/programming knowledge. Keep the genuine condition if retained, but explain the underlying time-scale idea in ordinary language rather than merely reproducing API notation.
directedDefects.directedAction: Make the pause example self-contained in ordinary Russian: explain the in-game-time scale/what zero means, and preserve any material applicability condition. The existing officialUnity context may be retained; no new source-class requirement or blanket ban is introduced. Alternatively use a directly relevant accessible pause fact with complete primary support. Do not change already valid key/prompt merely to fit an API quote.

directedDefects.literal: В Unity WorldAnchorStore методы Delete и Clear удаляют один сохранённый якорь или все записи якорей.
directedDefects.ground: Unity2018.3L104 directly supportsDelete removingoneWorldAnchor andClear removingallanchors. HoweverL76 explicitly defines these as saved physical-world locations, e.g.gameboard placement across launches, not undifferentiated game-progress files. Current note namesWorldAnchorStore and «якорь» without telling the reader what is stored or why this is a relevant saved-data example, and omits the historical2018.3/HoloLens context. The API facts are true in the retained manual, but the selected phrasing is not a standalone useful fact for the own generic «Удалить сохранённые данные» option. A clearly explained spatial-location example could be valid; the source class is not banned.
directedDefects.directedAction: Explain what a stored spatialanchor represents and the historicalHoloLens/Unity2018.3 scope if retaining this example, so the reader can understand which dataDelete/Clear removes. Or replace with an accessible fact specifically about deleting actual game-save data. Do not implyWorldAnchorStore deletes all player-progress saves or that the old API is unqualified currentUnity functionality.
